_comment: Guardrails. The pipeline has no limits of its own beyond these. Every item marked CONFIRM is a placeholder: check it against TQL's actual written policy / your manager and edit. Nothing here is official TQL policy.
_auto_send_email: Hard-coded off. The pipeline drafts; you send from your TQL account so it's logged in TQL's systems.
_require_crm_ownership_check: CONFIRM: before first contact, check TQL's CRM that the account isn't already a customer or owned/worked by another rep. Record result with `outcome <domain> owned_by_other_rep` or `existing_customer`.
_forwarders_require_manager_ok: CONFIRM: forwarder leads are allowed (not capped) but every card and Desk record says to get a manager OK first.
_broker_3pl_requires_manager_ok: Brokers/3PLs/forwarders are capped at MAYBE until you get a manager OK.
_blocked_domains: Never crawled (terms of service). Research contacts there by hand.
_parallel_sites: Different companies crawled at once. Each site still gets one request at a time with the delay above.
_recontact_cooldown_days: CONFIRM: how soon TQL lets you re-touch a prospect who didn't answer.
_followup_days: Touch 2 goes 3 days after touch 1, touch 3 goes 7 days after touch 2. Then log no_response.
_not_interested_cooldown_days: CONFIRM: when a 'not right now' can be re-approached.
_require_gates: Every pipeline lead must pass all three: no own fleet (FMCSA + website), ships interstate, uses outside carriers. Anything failing or unconfirmed is held, never queued or exported.
_fleet_min_power_units: A registered FMCSA fleet of this many trucks or more counts as 'has its own fleet'.

customer_plan._benchmark_customer_rate: ASSUMPTION until you have data: ~2% of fully worked, well-qualified shippers become customers. Your own results replace it automatically.

_max_new_contacts_per_day: null = no cap. Set a number only if TQL policy has one.

email_rules._honor_opt_outs: Anyone who says stop goes on `outcome <domain> do_not_contact` and is suppressed forever (CAN-SPAM / CASL).
